messages:
incident-bot: Pager: high-sev: routing_fallback_loop detected for customer 'acme-fin' — elevated error rate and latency spike. Pager fired to #incidents and oncall(sara).

sara (oncall): acked. I'm looking. Symptoms: 503s + long tails for text-generation calls, spike at 19:02 UTC.

emily (customer-success): customer reported repeated invalid outputs and timeouts. They've paused traffic to our API from their prod cluster.

sara (oncall): quick check: routes show repeated fallback from eu-west -> us-west -> eu-west, looped. metrics: error_rate ~ 12%, p95 latency ~ 1800ms.

matt (sre): can you dump the routing_decision logs for one request?

sara (oncall): grabbing sample now.

sara (oncall): log snippet for request id 7b8c: 
```
{"request_id":"7b8c","initial_route":"eu-west/variant-A","decision_sequence":[{"policy":"smart-route-v2","action":"route","target":"eu-west/variant-A"},{"policy":"fallback-check","action":"route","target":"us-west/variant-B"},{"policy":"fallback-check","action":"route","target":"eu-west/variant-A"}],"route_tag":null}
```

jenny (eng-runtime): that route_tag:null is bad. We should be emitting route_tag and decision_reason for each decision. Without that we can't tell which policy triggered fallback.

pradeep (eng-platform): agreed. Also looks like variant-B is an incompatible quantized model for this customer workload; unknown why fallback selected it. Could be a policy mismatch (policy is matching by region cost first).

kevin (prod): impact: 1 enterprise customer degraded (acme-fin), also see 3 dev teams hitting elevated error rates — potential SLA hit. Need immediate mitigation + postmortem.

sara (oncall): mitigation plan (live):
- scale up eu-west dedicated pool + temporarily increase capacity weight for acme-fin.
- disable cross-region fallback in smart-route-v2 for acme-fin (force pinned route to eu-west).
- open emergency ticket to add route_tag and decision_reason to routing_decision logs.

matt (sre): I'll take scaling and the routing lock. Jenny, can you confirm quick config change?

jenny (eng-runtime): on it. applying routing lock now:
```bash
redwoodctl routing patch --customer acme-fin --policy smart-route-v2 --set "allow_cross_region=false,preferred_regions=['eu-west']" --reason "emergency lock due to fallback loop 1802103456"
```

jenny (eng-runtime): applied. verifying.

matt (sre): scaling eu-west by +2 nodes via infra autoscale API:
```bash
infra-scale --pool eu-west-dedicated --delta 2 --tags "acme-fin-emergency"
```

matt (sre): scale confirmed, nodes joining cluster.

sara (oncall): after locking policy and scaling: error_rate down to 2%, p95 320ms. Customer re-enabled traffic and reports improvement. :thumbsup:

emily (customer-success): acme-fin confirmed normalizing behavior, very grateful. I'll send a short note and schedule follow-up call.

pradeep (eng-platform): root cause hypothesis: smart-route-v2 fallback logic prioritized availability cost heuristics but didn't validate model_variant compatibility. Also missing route_tag/decision_reason made triage slow.

jenny (eng-runtime): creating emergency PR to emit route_tag and decision_reason for every routing decision. Patch also adds a debug field show_policy_version.

jenny (eng-runtime): PR created: https://git.internal/rw/routing/pulls/4522 — patch will: 
- add route_tag (string) to routing_decision event
- add decision_reason enum (capacity|latency|error|policy_override)
- include policy_version on decision event

sara (oncall): for immediate observability, can we insert a logging shim to backfill recent decisions?

pradeep (eng-platform): we can backfill from the trace-store but it's missing route metadata. We'll add a temporary correlation: annotate traces with last_known_route from edge logs and surface in dashboard. I'll open ticket to extend trace ingestion.

kevin (prod): also, need to rollback any policy changes to stable once we have fixes and test. Create canary for smart-route-v2 with variant compatibility checks.

olivia (pm): schedule postmortem and action items:
- immediate: release routing lock (after confidence window), hotfix logs (jenny), platform backfill (pradeep), customer comms (emily)
- short term (48h): add variant compatibility check to routing engine, add unit/e2e tests for fallback loops, add trace tags
- long term: change smart-route rollout to require decision_reason telemetry before canary -> prod.

matt (sre): handing off pager to night oncall (matt -> sara was initial, now handing to matt for next 2 hours while I monitor).

sara (oncall): handing to matt. summary pinned above.

matt (sre): ack. I'll monitor alerts and roll forward the PRs if green.

jenny (eng-runtime): hotfix merged to staging (route tags + reasons). will be promoted to prod behind a feature flag in 15m.

pradeep (eng-platform): created infra ticket RW-9981 to update trace ingestion to include routing fields; ETA 3d.

olivia (pm): I'll own the postmortem doc and distribute to stakeholders. Assign owners: jenny (runtime fix), pradeep (trace ingestion), matt (runbook update), emily (customer follow-up), kevin (SLA communication).

emily (customer-success): sending immediate status update to acme-fin now.

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=high -> investigating. Link: https://incidents.internal/1802103456

matt (sre): monitoring window 30m -> all clear so far. will reopen if regressions.

sara (oncall): great teamwork, any outstanding asks?

jenny (eng-runtime): will push prod feature flag in 15m and follow up with logs confirm.

kevin (prod): please add a short blameless note in the PM doc about cross-region policy preferences vs variant compatibility.

olivia (pm): noted. closing incident thread after postmortem created.

incident-bot: Pager cleared by matt at 19:42 UTC."
